description: Top-center notch/pill with a clock that expands into a compact, flat native-style layout: a small dense calendar and notifications on the notch surface (no cards or tiles), icon-only quick actions, a separate minimal timer page, and a running-applications icon row with an Activities Overview button. GNOME notifications are mirrored into the island (stock banners replaced by an island peek + list). Configurable panel background with smooth Overview transitions. GNOME Shell 51.
name: Dynamic Notch
